params.name: QUERY
params.value:
"MERGE " + context.parameter_Env_Prefix + "." + (String)globalMap.get("parameter_table_name_bc") + " T
USING (
  SELECT * EXCEPT(rn)
  FROM (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY systemId ORDER BY SystemModifiedAt DESC) AS rn
    FROM " + context.parameter_Env_Prefix + "." + (String)globalMap.get("parameter_table_name_bc") + "Delta
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
) D
ON T.systemId = D.systemId

WHEN MATCHED AND (
  T.SystemModifiedAt IS NULL OR D.SystemModifiedAt > T.SystemModifiedAt
) THEN
UPDATE SET
  Blocked_1                 = D.Blocked_1,
  Code                      = D.Code,
  ConsolidationCode         = D.ConsolidationCode,
  DimensionCode             = D.DimensionCode,
  DimensionID               = D.DimensionID,
  DimensionValueID          = D.DimensionValueID,
  DimensionValueType        = D.DimensionValueType,
  GlobalDimensionNumber     = D.GlobalDimensionNumber,
  IDLDimGroupCode_ADI       = D.IDLDimGroupCode_ADI,
  Indentation               = D.Indentation,
  LastModifiedDateTime      = D.LastModifiedDateTime,
  MaptoICDimensionCode      = D.MaptoICDimensionCode,
  MaptoICDimensionValueCode = D.MaptoICDimensionValueCode,
  Name                      = D.Name,
  SystemCreatedAt           = D.SystemCreatedAt,
  SystemCreatedBy           = D.SystemCreatedBy,
  SystemModifiedAt          = D.SystemModifiedAt,
  SystemModifiedBy          = D.SystemModifiedBy,
  Totaling                  = D.Totaling

WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN
INSERT (
  systemId,
  Blocked_1,
  Code,
  ConsolidationCode,
  DimensionCode,
  DimensionID,
  DimensionValueID,
  DimensionValueType,
  GlobalDimensionNumber,
  IDLDimGroupCode_ADI,
  Indentation,
  LastModifiedDateTime,
  MaptoICDimensionCode,
  MaptoICDimensionValueCode,
  Name,
  SystemCreatedAt,
  SystemCreatedBy,
  SystemModifiedAt,
  SystemModifiedBy,
  Totaling
)
VALUES (
  D.systemId,
  D.Blocked_1,
  D.Code,
  D.ConsolidationCode,
  D.DimensionCode,
  D.DimensionID,
  D.DimensionValueID,
  D.DimensionValueType,
  D.GlobalDimensionNumber,
  D.IDLDimGroupCode_ADI,
  D.Indentation,
  D.LastModifiedDateTime,
  D.MaptoICDimensionCode,
  D.MaptoICDimensionValueCode,
  D.Name,
  D.SystemCreatedAt,
  D.SystemCreatedBy,
  D.SystemModifiedAt,
  D.SystemModifiedBy,
  D.Totaling
)"
